d:
Born in Dehradun on 14th June 1989, Jubin Nautiyal is a well known singer.
His father, Ram Sharan Nautiyal is a businessman and a politician while his mother Neena Nautiyal is a businesswoman. Jubin came into the limelight after appearing in a music reality show 'X Factor' in 2011. His debut song 'Ek Mulaqat' released in 2014 from the film 'Sonali Cable'.
